summary: Rezones properties on Buena Vista Pike and Cliff Drive, at the southwest corner of Buena Vista Pike and Cliff Drive (5.29 acres), from R8 to SP zoning for a mixed-use development. It allows up to 225 residential units in all districts and up to 12,100 square feet of nonresidential uses in District 1, and bans short-term rentals in Districts 2 and 3.
